Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the evidence from the WebSurfer’s Step 11 (which showed IMDb company credits for Unbreakable including Blinding Edge Pictures) and incorrectly switched the target to “The Kid (2000).” This conflated Touchstone’s involvement with a different Bruce Willis film and ignored the confirmation that Unbreakable (2000) was produced by Blinding Edge Pictures. The error was a premature, contradictory conclusion based on misreading the gathered evidence.
